journey.name: Send first message: a reply streams in
journey.description: A new user starts a chat, sends a message, and watches the reply stream in. The chat then appears in the list with its snippet.

actions.action: Verify the chat list shows the empty state "Hmmm, a bit quiet here"
Type "Reply with exactly: Hello" into the message field
Verify the typed message appears as a bubble on the right
Wait until a reply bubble appears on the left containing "Hello"
Verify the list now shows one chat whose title is the message that was sent
Verify that item's second line shows the reply text
